frequency_question: How often do announced indefinite strikes successfully launch by the exact deadline without being called off, deferred, or converted to a shorter/alternative action?
membership_rule: Members are major union strike threats with explicit deadlines. Excluded are wildcat strikes without formal union backing or actions without specific calendar deadlines.

cases.name: All India Bank Employees Association strike Mar 2021

coverage_note: 5 representative high-profile bank union strike notices in India over the past decade
known_gaps: Excludes smaller regional cooperative bank strikes
skeleton: Union strike execution rate based on historical Indian bank union strike calls resulting in actual commencement versus last-minute conciliation settlements or postponements.
multiplier: 2 hits out of 5 documented major strike notice cycles leading up to firm execution dates
validity_reason: Labor negotiation dynamics and conciliation frameworks change slowly over multi-year periods
